change_summary: Stage original ESPN Site v2 final event bytes and partial supported player stats for NFL, CFB, CBB, NBA and MLB. Strict period totals, team/event IDs, capture clock and private-file guards; no official odds, release or ledger mutation. Depends on #397 result-only grader.
assumptions: Public ESPN Site v2 summaries are unofficial sources; successfully parsed bytes and capture time do not independently prove provider publication timing or historical point-in-time status.
Player-stat categories are incomplete and may change; unknown or conflicting fields must stay ungraded, never zero-filled.
Neither ESPN athlete/event IDs nor sportsbook identifiers can be mapped without independent event/player crosswalk review.
